scope: Focused visual review of the K115 standard-response concealed sprinkler temperature photograph section after the passing browser checks.

observations: The lower photograph section displays a consistent three-column desktop grid.
The reused 57°C covered and exposed photographs appear first, followed by the 79°C pair.
The complete product outlines, white cover plates, factory labels and exposed mechanisms remain visible.
Captions and enlarge links are readable; watermark text stays in clear background space.
The final 141°C covered and exposed photographs are displayed in the expected order.
The exposed blue-bulb sample is fully visible within the mobile card.
Arabic captions and the enlarge link wrap inside the card without clipping or horizontal overflow.
The photograph section ends before the independent configuration section.
